Join Our Team

We're building the future of analytics. Come help us make data accessible to everyone.

Why Work at Acme?

Remote-First

Work from anywhere in the world. We're a distributed team across 15 countries.

Competitive Compensation

Top-of-market salaries, equity packages, and comprehensive benefits.

Learning Budget

$3,000 annual budget for courses, conferences, and books.

Flexible PTO

Unlimited vacation policy with minimum 3 weeks encouraged.

Open Positions

Senior Software Engineer - Backend

Remote (US/EU timezones)

Full-time

Join our platform team to build scalable data infrastructure that processes billions of events daily.

Salary range: $180,000 - $220,000

Apply Now

Product Designer

Remote (Any timezone)

Full-time

Design intuitive experiences that help customers understand their data at a glance.

Salary range: $150,000 - $180,000

Apply Now

Machine Learning Engineer

Remote (US/EU timezones)

Full-time

Build AI models that automatically surface insights from customer data.

Salary range: $200,000 - $250,000

Apply Now

Developer Advocate

San Francisco, CA or Remote (US)

Full-time

Help developers succeed with our APIs through content, demos, and community engagement.

Salary range: $140,000 - $170,000

Apply Now

Meet the Team

We're a team of 45 people passionate about making data analytics accessible to everyone. Founded in 2020, we've grown from a small startup to serving over 10,000 customers worldwide.
